name: Coffee Yeou Kim Samwol
source: A special fantasy romance visual novel arrives, unfolding in a small modern city cafe with 'Kim Sam-wol,' a nine-tailed fox who has lived for 3,000 years. Why did she, who sought to become a deity by eating human livers, awaken as an ordinary human and work part-time at a cafe?
translation: 一部特别的奇幻浪漫视觉小说即将到来，故事发生在一家现代化的城市小咖啡馆里，主角是一只活了3000岁的九尾狐狸“金三月”。为何靠吃人肝成神的她，会觉醒成为普通人，在咖啡馆打工？
